name: THE SUMERIAN — LTX PRODUCTION PIPELINE v1.1

parameters.content:
## 01–03 · RECEIVE (WEBHOOK ONLY), VALIDATE, NORMALIZE
**Human → THE SUMERIAN — PRODUCTION FORMS v1.1 → protected webhook (X-Sumerian-Key) → 01A.** This workflow exposes no form.
Node 03 maps the internal schema to LTX v2. DRAFT = ltx-2-3-fast **720p** · STANDARD = ltx-2-3-pro 1080p · FINAL = ltx-2-5-pro 1080p.

## 04–05 · SAFETY / APPROVAL GATE
`generation_authorized` must be **true**. Cost estimate vs `max_generation_cost`. SHOT_ID+VERSION duplicate check, then a **SUBMITTING** reservation row *before* any paid call.

**VERSION DISCIPLINE:** shot_id is permanent; a creative revision = version + 1 with authorized=false.
**force_regenerate = EXCEPTIONAL RECOVERY ONLY** (terminal LTX failure, failed technical submission, infra failure with no valid output, deliberate operator rerun). Requires `force_regenerate_reason`; only re-opens FAILED attempts; never re-renders a completed or archive-failed clip.

## 06–09 · ROUTE, PREPARE, SUBMIT (PAID)
Only path that spends LTX credits. No automatic retries on submit.

## 10–12 · ASYNC POLLING
Wait 20 s → GET job → bounded loop (max 45 polls / 20 min). Transient errors tolerated 5×.

## 13 · CAPTURE → ARCHIVE (CLOUDINARY)
Temporary LTX URL is written to the library **first** (ARCHIVING). Then Cloudinary upload, max **3** attempts, transient errors only, 10 s apart.
Failure → **ARCHIVE_FAILED** (temp URL kept, no new render; repair via Archive Repair form). Never REVIEW_REQUIRED without a permanent URL.

## 14–16 · LIBRARY → REVIEW_REQUIRED
Only after archive success. Never auto-approved.

## ERROR · HANDLE FAILURE
One structured error shape. Updates the library row only when this run created the reservation. Credentials are never included.
